title: GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Tracks and Six Available Now
description: GTA 6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed, featuring 34 tracks from real-world artists, with six tracks available to stream today.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Soundtrack Details Emerge

According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, details regarding the original soundtrack for Grand Theft Auto 6 have partially emerged. Music has always played a vital role in shaping the atmosphere of the open-world crime franchise, and the upcoming title appears to be continuing that tradition with a substantial musical lineup.

The full album for GTA 6 is set to feature 34 original tracks created specifically for the game. These tracks include contributions from multiple real-world artists, showcasing the developers' continued commitment to blending authentic music culture with interactive entertainment.

## Six Tracks Available to Stream Today

Fans eager to get a taste of the game's audio landscape do not have to wait until launch. Alongside the partial reveal, it was announced that six of these tracks are available to stream today. This allows players to experience a portion of the game's musical direction ahead of release, giving a glimpse into the sonic identity of the next installment in the iconic series.

While further details about the complete tracklist, in-game radio stations, and participating artists will likely be shared as the release approaches, today's music drop provides an exciting preview for the community.

## Editor's Take

Music is the beating heart of the GTA experience. Revealing a 34-track original soundtrack and immediately streaming six songs is a brilliant way to build momentum. It keeps the community engaged and highlights Rockstar's meticulous attention to audio-visual immersion in GTA 6.
